{{Quote|With the Emperor dead, the Empire will be in chaos. Most of the ships from the Kuat blockade will have returned from the battle over Endor to regroup. The time to strike is now! We must take control of the Eclipse.|[[Tyber Zann]]|<ref name="Forces of Corruption" />}}
The '''Kuat blockade''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The blockade was under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaarn]].

==Composition==
An [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]], the [[Annihilator (Executor-class)/Legends|''Annihilator'']], served as the blockade's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Multiple capital ships, such as [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] also served in the fleet. Various support vessels, such as [[Broadside-class cruiser kdb-1|''Broadside''-class cruisers]], [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruisers]], and [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]].<ref name="Forces of Corruption" />

Various TIE series models, such as the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]], and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] were a part of the blockade as well.

The blockade made use of three [[Cardan V-class space station|''Cardan V''-class space stations]], which were mainly used in protection of the yet completed [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], which was an [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnought]]. At least five [[Plasma Defense Satellite]]s, and three [[Orbital repair satellite|Orbital Repair Satellites]] were used as well.<ref name="Forces of Corruption" />
